description: Without id: lists the model's sections (id, name, type, whether Section Designer stores it as outlines) and the next free id. With id: returns the section as outlines in section_preview's input format, in units (default mm). A drawn section (VALUE/GEN, PSC/VALU, COMPOSITE-GEN) comes back with its stored properties; any other type (DB/User shapes, PSC guide-curve sections, steel girders with stiffeners and riveted angles, composite girders, tapered) is rebuilt by the section library and checked against the properties CIVIL NX published, with a note saying what was recovered — edit it and write it back with section_write.

at.description: Tapered sections only: station along the length, 0 = I end (default), 1 = J end.

name: section_read
title: Section Designer — read sections from the model
